ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Git Clone
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "git" in order to clone a remote repository that contain suspicious keywords which might be suspicious

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\git\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\git\\-remote\\-https\\\.exe$")) OR process_original_file_name = "git\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ clone\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*git\\-remote\\-https\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*exploit.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Vulns.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*vulnerability.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*RemoteCodeExecution.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Invoke\\-.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*CVE\\-.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*poc\\-.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ProofOfConcept.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*proxyshell.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*log4shell.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*eternalblue.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*eternal\\-blue.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*MS17\\-.*")))
